summary: Property possession dispute; suit under Specific Relief Act questioned; amendment of plaint allowed; Trial Court decreed possession of B schedule property and permanent injunction for C schedule; High Court remand for additional evidence; Supreme Court clarified remand scope; High Court later affirmed Trial Court decree; interlocutory applications on amendment rejected; final judgment sustaining possession and injunction
legal_provisions_cited: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 6 Rule 17
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order 41 Rule 2
Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 Order XLI Rule 27
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; Trial Court judgment affirmed; High Court decision upheld.
